adsense._consent_mode_help: 'self' = the built-in banner gates ad loading; use only where a certified CMP is not required. 'google_cmp' = you have configured Google's Funding Choices / Privacy & messaging CMP, which is MANDATORY for serving personalised ads to visitors in the EEA, the UK or Switzerland.

editorial._review_mode_help: 'hold_then_publish' = each edition is held in an open pull request for hold_hours. Merging the PR marks it editor-approved. If the window expires it publishes anyway, marked as NOT reviewed. 'hold_until_approved' = the same, but an unapproved edition never publishes. 'publish_immediately' = no gate at all. The public wording on every article changes to match whichever mode is set AND what actually happened to that edition.
editorial._reviewer_credit_help: How the reviewer is described on approved articles. Keep it accurate — use a role, or a real name if you want to be named. Never a job title nobody holds.

_url_help: Full public base of the site. A path after the host (e.g. /richmond-wire) is treated as a base path and prefixed onto every internal link, the sitemap and the feed. Point a custom domain here later and the base path disappears on its own.
